# Query cookbook (controller API)
All queries are keyset reads. `cursor` is an opaque encoding of the last returned `(commit_seq, record_id)`; clients never use timestamps or offsets. Each entry states both success and the stable error envelope `{code, detail, request_id}`.

## Q1 — get one ticket `GET /v1/tickets/WF01-002`
Expected result: `200` with the effective ticket revision, latest event, dependency statuses, and `next_cursor: null`. Expected error: `404 {"code":"not_found"}` for an unreadable or unknown ticket.

## Q2 — stale transition `POST /v1/tickets/WF01-002/transitions` with `expected_revision: 1`, `to: "in_progress"`.
Expected result: `409 {"code":"ticket_revision_conflict","current_revision":2}` and **no** TicketRecord, event, link, or audit-success mutation. Expected error shape: the same conflict envelope; caller must re-read and retry with revision 2.

## Q3 — retry after conflict Read Q1, then submit the same transition with the returned revision and a fresh request id.
Expected result: `200`, exactly one revision increment and one event. A replay of the same request id returns the original `200` without another event. Expected error: `403 {"code":"ticket_transition_not_allowed"}` when the machine edge or actor is invalid.

## Q4 — dependency-gated query `GET /v1/tickets?state=ready&cursor=<cursor>`
Expected result: only tickets whose every dependency is non-terminal-success (`accepted`/`done`) and whose parent facts are valid. A dependency in `cancelled`, `failed`, `expired`, or `rejected` is unsatisfied and the dependent is absent or `blocked`. Expected error: `400 {"code":"cursor_invalid"}` for a malformed cursor.

## Q5 — idempotent intake `POST /v1/tickets` with `request_id: "wf03:event-7"`, `source: "intake"`, `source_ref: "event-7"`, twice.
Expected result: first call `201`; second call `200` with the same `ticket_id`, `duplicate: true`, and exactly one logical ticket in the source thread. Expected error: `409 {"code":"duplicate_identity_conflict"}` only when the same source identity carries incompatible immutable fields.

## Q6 — dataset keyset read `GET /v1/reports/r-001/dataset?order_by=row_id%20ASC&page_size=100&cursor=...`
Expected result: published rows in `(row_id)` order and a cursor; no offset. Expected error: `422 {"code":"dataset_query_invalid","field":"order_by"}` for an undeclared column or unsupported operator.

## Q7 — archive coverage `GET /v1/archive/sup-1?cursor=...`
Expected result: committed manifests and named open gaps, re-authorized for each page. Expected error: `404 {"code":"not_found"}` for missing or unauthorized archive scope (non-oracle).

## Q8 — effective revision `GET /v1/records/chd/ticket/WF01-002?historical=true`
Expected result: highest `rev`; equal-rev records are accepted only when canonical bytes are identical. Expected error: `500 {"code":"integrity_equal_rev_conflict"}` with an incident reference when equal-rev bytes differ.

## Q9 — ticket export mirror `GET /v1/tickets/export?format=jsonl&cursor=...`
Expected result: a boardctl-compatible view marked `authority: controller`; local edits, worktrees and artifacts cannot change it. Expected error: `403 {"code":"export_not_granted"}` when the caller lacks read scope.
